outcomes.answer: Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes) leads the 2026 drivers' championship with 292 points and 8 wins, 81 ahead of teammate George Russell on 211. However, the latest standings on the site are after round 14, the Spanish Grand Prix, so they may not reflect any later rounds. You can see the full table on the [2026 season page](/seasons/2026) or the [2026 Spanish Grand Prix](/seasons/2026/races/14).

Max Verstappen won the 2021 Monaco Grand Prix for Red Bull, starting from second on the grid. Carlos Sainz Jr. (Ferrari) finished second and Lando Norris (McLaren) third.

You can see the full results at [2021 Monaco Grand Prix](/seasons/2021/races/5).

Lewis Hamilton holds the all-time record for race wins with 106, from 394 starts. Michael Schumacher is second with 91 wins, and Max Verstappen is third with 71.

You can see the full ranking on the [all-time records page](/records).

You can compare two drivers on the [Compare drivers page](/compare/drivers), which shows their careers side by side with head-to-head race and qualifying results. For a single season, use the [Compare page](/compare), where you can pick two drivers or two constructors and see their points, wins, podiums and poles for that year.

Nico Rosberg won the 2016 World Drivers' Championship for Mercedes, and Mercedes also took the constructors' title that year. The season ran 21 rounds, all completed.

[2016 season](/seasons/2016)

Fernando Alonso (ALO) is a Spanish driver born 29 July 1981. He has 442 starts, 32 wins, 106 podiums, 23 poles, 26 fastest laps, 2 championships and 2,383 career points. You can see his full profile at [Fernando Alonso's driver page](/drivers/fernando-alonso).

The next race countdown is shown on the Home page, which is the page you're already on. It appears alongside the championship leader, top-5 standings, last podium, title permutations and the world tour map.

[Home](/)

Kimi Antonelli won the most recent race with a recorded result: the Spanish Grand Prix at Circuito de Madring, round 14 on 13 September 2026. The rounds after it (Azerbaijan through the United States Grand Prix) have no winner recorded yet, so the site may not have their results. You can see the full race page here: [2026 Spanish Grand Prix](/seasons/2026/races/14).
Lewis Hamilton has 7 championships, according to the site's career totals, with 106 wins and 207 podiums across 394 starts. You can see his full profile at [Lewis Hamilton](/drivers/lewis-hamilton).

The full list of drivers' and constructors' champions is on the Champions page, which shows every season's title winners. You can also browse the Seasons page, which has one tile per year with its champion.

[Champions](/champions) · [Seasons](/seasons)

Lewis Hamilton won the 2008 drivers' title with 98 points, one point ahead of Felipe Massa on 97. The table is taken after round 18, the Brazilian Grand Prix, which was the season's final round.

You can see the full table on the [2008 season page](/seasons/2008) or the [Brazilian Grand Prix](/seasons/2008/races/18).

Max Verstappen (Red Bull) took pole for the 2021 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, with a best qualifying time of 1:22.109. Lewis Hamilton (Mercedes) finished second in the race, 2.256 seconds behind Verstappen, who won.

[2021 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix](/seasons/2021/races/22)

Ayrton Senna took 41 wins and 65 poles in his career, from 162 starts. He also had 80 podiums, 19 fastest laps and 3 championships. You can see his full career profile on [Ayrton Senna's driver page](/drivers/ayrton-senna).

The 2007 drivers' championship top three, after the final round (Brazilian Grand Prix, round 17), were:

1. Kimi Räikkönen (Ferrari): 110 points
2. Lewis Hamilton (McLaren): 109 points
3. Fernando Alonso (McLaren): 109 points

Räikkönen won the title by a single point over Hamilton and Alonso, who tied on points. Full season details are on the [2007 season page](/seasons/2007).

Lewis Hamilton holds the all-time record for pole positions among drivers, with 105 from 394 starts. Michael Schumacher is second with 69, followed by Ayrton Senna with 65.

You can see the full ranking on the [records page](/records).

Lewis Hamilton is the British driver with the most Grand Prix wins, with 106 from 394 starts. Nigel Mansell is second among British drivers with 31 wins from 191 starts, followed by Jackie Stewart (27) and Jim Clark (25).

[Lewis Hamilton's profile](/drivers/lewis-hamilton) · [Nigel Mansell's profile](/drivers/nigel-mansell)

Michael Schumacher won the most races between 1990 and 1999, with 35 wins from 128 starts in that span. Damon Hill was second with 22 wins, and Ayrton Senna third with 21.

[Michael Schumacher's profile](/drivers/michael-schumacher)

Juan Manuel Fangio has the highest win rate among drivers with at least 20 starts, at about 43.1% (wins in 22 of 51 starts). Alberto Ascari is next at about 40.6% over 32 starts, followed by Jim Clark at about 34.3% over 73 starts.

[All-time win rate records](/records)

Max Verstappen won the 2024 drivers' championship, finishing first with 437 points and 9 wins. He led Lando Norris (374 points) at the end of the season's final round, the 2024 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.

[2024 season standings](/seasons/2024)

The podium for round 1 of 2024 (the Bahrain Grand Prix) was:

1. Max Verstappen (Red Bull), who started from pole
2. Sergio Pérez (Red Bull)
3. Carlos Sainz Jr. (Ferrari)

See the full results at [2024 Bahrain Grand Prix](/seasons/2024/races/1).

Lando Norris finished the 2025 season with 423 points and won the drivers' championship, finishing 2 points ahead of Max Verstappen (421) after the final round, the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix. He also took 7 wins that season.

[2025 season standings](/seasons/2025)

McLaren won the 2024 constructors' championship with 666 points, after the final round (Abu Dhabi Grand Prix). Ferrari finished second on 652 points, and McLaren took six wins to Ferrari's five.

You can see the full table on the [2024 season page](/seasons/2024), or the final round at the [2024 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix](/seasons/2024/races/24).

After the Spanish Grand Prix (round 14), the latest round with results, **Mercedes** lead the 2026 constructors' standings with 468 points and 10 wins. **Ferrari** are second on 346 points with 2 wins.

See the full table on the [2026 season page](/seasons/2026) or the [2026 Spanish Grand Prix](/seasons/2026/races/14).

The fastest lap at the 2021 Monaco Grand Prix was set by Lewis Hamilton (Mercedes) with a time of 1:12.909 on lap 69. Verstappen won the race, so Hamilton's lap was the quickest of the weekend even though he finished seventh.

[2021 Monaco Grand Prix](/seasons/2021/races/5)
Kimi Antonelli is Italian, according to the site's driver listing. You can see his profile at [Kimi Antonelli](/drivers/kimi-antonelli).

The top five drivers by career podium finishes are:

1. Lewis Hamilton: 207
2. Michael Schumacher: 155
3. Max Verstappen: 133
4. Sebastian Vettel: 122
5. Fernando Alonso: 106

You can see the full ranking on the [all-time records page](/records).

Lewis Hamilton scored more career points: 5,126.5 to Michael Schumacher's 1,566.0. Hamilton also has more starts (394 to 308), wins (106 to 91) and podiums (207 to 155), while both have seven championships.

You can compare the two careers side by side on the [driver comparison page](/compare/drivers?d1=michael-schumacher&d2=lewis-hamilton), or see Hamilton's full profile at [/drivers/lewis-hamilton](/drivers/lewis-hamilton).

Ayrton Senna won the 1988 drivers' championship with **90 points** (his official total after the best-results rule dropped 4), ahead of Alain Prost on 87. Both drove for McLaren, and Senna took eight wins to Prost's seven. Standings are from the table after round 16, the final round of the season.

See the full [1988 season](/seasons/1988) or [Ayrton Senna's profile](/drivers/ayrton-senna).

Max Verstappen won the most races in 2025, with 8 wins. He did not win the title: Lando Norris took the championship by 2 points (423 to 421) after the final round, the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix. Verstappen finished second, and Norris's McLaren team also took the constructors' title.

[2025 season](/seasons/2025)

The most recent 2026 race with results on the site is the Spanish Grand Prix (round 14, 13 September). George Russell set the fastest lap there, a 1:35.587 on lap 49. The Azerbaijan Grand Prix (round 15) and later rounds have no results data yet, so I can't confirm whether any of them have been run.
